    AI Overview
    WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for Saturday, April 18, and Sunday, April 19, 2026, at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada. The two-night event will be available for streaming, with both nights expected to begin around 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT. 
    Key Details for WrestleMania 2026: 
    • Dates: April 18–19, 2026
    • Location: Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas (Paradise, Nevada)
    • Event: WrestleMania 42
    • Streaming/Broadcasting:
      WWE, ESPN (U.S.), Netflix (International)
       
    Tickets are available through Ticketmaster, including two-day combos, as noted in the Ticketmaster event listing.

    WrestleMania 42 (2026) will take place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada (specifically in Paradise, NV) over two nights on Saturday, April 18, and Sunday, April 19, 2026. This marks the second consecutive year the event is held in Las Vegas. 
    • Venue: Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas, NV
    • Dates: April 18–19, 2026
    • Event: WrestleMania 42 / WrestleMania Saturday & Sunday 
    Tickets are available through Ticketmaster.
